rootCauses.impact: CMS text was executed in the visitor origin after a click. A malicious CMS edit could execute arbitrary client code. High impact; content-publishing access required.
rootCauses.fix: Map of application-owned callbacks, selected by exact CMS action name. No string evaluation. Unknown actions fail closed. Explicit React callback precedence preserved.
rootCauses.migration: Move existing CMS JavaScript snippets into application-owned callbacks; CMS field now contains registered name.

rootCauses.impact: Raw external product HTML reached a browser HTML sink. Exploitation requires malicious product/import data reaching this prop; no evidence of an actual attack.
rootCauses.fix: sanitize-html at the sink, allowlisted formatting/links/images; removes executable tags, event attributes, CSS and unsafe URL schemes on server and browser.

rootCauses.impact: Opened destination could retain a handle to the original tab. Lower practical risk with fixed wa.me destination.
rootCauses.fix: Open _blank with noopener; original tab is inaccessible to the opened page.
